purpose: Public health: deciding where to place prevention programmes for different age groups.
question: How many people with obesity are there in each federal state and age group?
definitions: Obesity = any diagnosis with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
Age groups by age on 31 December 2025: under 40, 40-64, 65+.
Count patients, one number for every combination of federal state and age group; list all combinations.
